supabase.description: Postgres database, auth, storage, and realtime via the official @supabase/supabase-js v2 client. Exposes both anon and service-role clients with normalized error handling.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
env.description: Your Supabase project URL (Project Settings -> API).

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
env.description: Public anon key — safe to expose in the browser. Used for public client operations.

env.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
env.description: Service-role key — server-side only. Bypasses RLS. Required when using `supabase.admin`.

paystack.description: Card payments, transfers, subscriptions, and customer management via the official paystack-sdk. Provides a .run() helper that converts the SDK's union response shape into normalized errors.

env.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Paystack secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Server-side only — never expose.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: Paystack public key (pk_test_... or pk_live_...). Used by the inline checkout widget in the browser.

qoreid.description: Identity, KYC, biometric, address, business, and asset verification across Africa via QoreID's REST API. Hand-rolled fetch client (QoreID has no first-party Node SDK) with OAuth2 client-credentials token caching, 401 retry, and HMAC-SHA512 webhook signature verification.

env.name: QOREID_CLIENT_ID
env.description: QoreID client ID (from Dashboard -> API Keys). Used to obtain a Bearer token at /token.

env.name: QOREID_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: QoreID client secret (from Dashboard -> API Keys). Server-side only — never expose.

env.name: QOREID_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.qoreid.com — only set this for testing or self-hosted proxies.

env.name: QOREID_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Secret used to verify inbound QoreID webhook signatures (HMAC-SHA512 over raw body, sent as x-qoreid-signature). Only required if you receive webhooks.

resend.description: Transactional email via the official resend SDK. Wraps the no-throw {data,error} response shape into normalized errors and exposes a sendEmail() shortcut with a default From address.

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.description: Resend API key (re_...). Create one at https://resend.com/api-keys.

env.name: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
env.description: Default sender address (must be on a verified domain).

posthog.description: Product analytics, feature flags, and session replay via the posthog-node SDK.
